newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: ARA bunkers soften, Med responds to Monday's gains.
newsitem.headline: ARA bunkers soften, Med responds to Monday's gains.

text.p: ARA bunkers softened while Mediterranean prices rose in a thin day's activity throughout Europe, dealers said.

Rotterdam 380 cst had dipped $2 to $119/$120 a tonne fob as barges sagged in the afternoon. Total enquiries in the Rotterdam area amounted to less than 10,000 tonnes. Other ARA ports fared little better.
Dealers said shipowners were convinced that further weakness was due.
The weakness restored the Hamburg/Rotterdam differential as Hamburg prices held.
Mediterranean ports responded to gains in Rotterdam on Monday. Spanish fuel oil bunkers were up $2 a tonne, and, in France, bunkers gained $1.
French flexibility was limited by the continuation of road blockades by French lorry drivers.
"We do not quote for small deliveries. We simply cannot load any trucks," one supplier said.
Softness in Singapore was behind losses in Fujairah. Fuel oil prices, already offered at discounts on Monday, nevertheless dipped $2 from year-highs to $116/$117.
